content: Maro Kindeni ikai Maro Ŋalae panzi tamâta ndoni
Miki tamâta lâ ŋgu ndoni, miki kandeka ku kaponza mbaumi! Miki kandeka ku kasuŋa kawami ŋalae kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa paneâŋa kâ pa Maro Kindeni!
I nde koipu ŋalae kaika ndo, aku i uru ikai poe panzi tamâta ndoni simo tâno kulu. Mine nde ara ŋana kinda rârâni ma tamege ŋana Yova Kindeni kâ, inani Yova Kindeni âta Tamwata.
I ivila kinda lâ, kala tapolenzi tinikoa ŋgu ndoni. Ionzi ŋgu ndoni simo kinda kalonda.
Yova Kindeni ilo ndo keno pa kinda. Mine kala nanayoni i tamwata ipatea tâno toŋge panzi ne ŋgu Isrel. Kala ŋine kinda tamo tava ndekâŋa nâ lâ tânoni ndaina.
Miki kamora ŋga! Maro Kindeni nde ikâki ilâ ne luma sapâŋa ilo kala imo ŋinde, aku tamâta sindeka ku sisarâwa kaika wa simbana tando wa.
Ayo, miki rârâni kagogo kawami kawâŋgi kapanea Maro Kindeni ŋa! Kawâŋgi pa nenda Koipu Ŋalae tava ndekâŋa nâ!
Ŋana tu Maro Kindeni imo koipu ŋalae, aku ikai maro pa tâno ndoni. Miki kawâŋgi wâŋgiŋa paneâŋa kâ ilâ papa i!
Mao nâ, Maro Kindeni imo koipu ŋalae ku ikai poe panzi tamâta ŋgu ndoni marumbu lâ. Isaŋona koipu ŋalae ne saŋonâŋa nia sapâŋa, aku imo ikai maro.

Kinda uru tapono muli pa Abraham ne Maro Kindeni, aku tamâta ŋgu ndoni nenzi koipu ŋalaŋala nde sipasau simâ taitu ku kinda, ŋana tu kinzi koipu ŋalaŋala rârâni nde simo Maro Kindeni kalo. I ikai maro ŋalae ikura tâno ndoni.
